media.description: Poster for the film Schuß im Morgengrauen (1932), directed by Alfred Zeisler; a European-period film with music by Bronisław Kaper (Film F015).
media.altText: Illustrated Film-Kurier cover for Schuß im Morgengrauen, showing film-promotion artwork and issue text.
media.rightsNote: Illustrierter Film-Kurier, no. 1789 (Berlin, 1932).
